method: Public directory snapshots plus at most four detail pages per HTML directory, npm first 250 keyword results, four targeted PyPI records; not exhaustive.
limitations: Community README entries are discovery candidates, not independently curated or audited connectors.
Dedupe by repository intentionally collapses monorepo subservers and does not identify forks.
HTML directories were sampled, not exhaustively crawled.
PyPI search returned a browser challenge; only four direct project JSON lookups were used.
Source listing text does not grant permission, verify free access or establish package safety.
